mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong supply-side growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative policy with strong supply growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases and FEDFUNDS decreases.
